001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Written for each signed BolusPermissionRequest a BLE app sends, immediately followed by a
009 * {@link BolusPermissionResponseHistoryLog}. Tandem publishes no name for opcode 338, so this class
010 * name is provisional. Bytes 14-25 were zero in every record observed.
011 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/142.
012 */
013@HistoryLogProps(
014    opCode = 338,
015    displayName = "Bolus Permission Request"
016)
017public class BolusPermissionRequestHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
018
019    private long requestTimestamp;
020
021    public BolusPermissionRequestHistoryLog() {}
022
023    public BolusPermissionRequestHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long requestTimestamp) {
024        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, requestTimestamp, 0);
025    }
026
027    public BolusPermissionRequestHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long requestTimestamp, int headerHighNibble) {
028        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
029        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, requestTimestamp, headerHighNibble);
030        this.requestTimestamp = requestTimestamp;
031    }
032
033    public int typeId() {
034        return 338;
035    }
036
037    /**
038     * <table border="1">
039     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusPermissionRequestHistoryLog:</caption>
040     * <tr><td><code>requestTimestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
041     * </table>
042     */
043    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
044        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
045        this.cargo = raw;
046        parseBase(raw);
047        this.requestTimestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
048    }
049
050    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long requestTimestamp, int headerHighNibble) {
051        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
052            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(338, headerHighNibble),
053            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
054            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
055            Bytes.toUint32(requestTimestamp)));
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * @return the 32-bit time value the app placed in the signed request's authentication trailer
060     * (the value {@link com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.Packetize} takes from
061     * {@code PumpStateSupplier.pumpTimeSinceReset}), copied as sent. It is the app's clock, not
062     * the pump's: requests from TandemKit carried the app's last-read
063     * TimeSinceResetResponse.pumpTimeSinceReset, so the value lags the record time by however long
064     * ago that was, while Tandem's app sent a value on the seconds-since-2008 pump-clock scale
065     * (equal to the last TimeSinceResetResponse.currentTime, or that plus a whole number of hours).
066     */
067    public long getRequestTimestamp() {
068        return requestTimestamp;
069    }
070}
